arm_notes.mdapy/knn: strict per-atom 4-nearest lists, symmetrised outside the timer to compare
arm_notes.ovito/knn: strict per-atom 4-nearest lists, symmetrised outside the timer to compare

arm_notes.pyscal3/knn: strict per-atom 4-nearest lists, symmetrised outside the timer to compare
arm_notes.seams/knn: undirected union of the 4-nearest-neighbour relations, rows may exceed 4
